test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A # B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

A @ B means ‘A is the son of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the father of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

If W @ Q % T & Y @ M % K, then how is W related to K?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png]

Given statement : **W @ Q % T & Y @ M % K**

So,

 
• W @ Q → W is the son of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1bf501ad753674c5a431406a375cf2a950e7c3e4f0982af177be982fb307cd3.png] 

 
• Q % T → Q is the mother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89d35a06bd7d12d91cb0c69f3103268b557438b61510f543b13e52aae9b3bfda.png] 

 
• T & Y → T is the father of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02b28e139c3c19827e7b6cf76b981f84540c423a13875008a92d21cba291b0ff.png] 

 
• Y @ M → Y is the son of M.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3226f9ca8c7442231381a283d06e0f490e2a1471bb8bf0e2937912487f4f7826.png] 

 
• 
 
M % K → M is the mother of K.

 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7af890c98ec173b3805de622b7c0543c7394cf7e3e7f3f87524fa3ff84913cd9.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree, W is the paternal uncle i.e father's brother of K.

Hence, "**Father’s brother**" is the correct answer.
